title: The House
dek: A house cut open from the roof to the garden: rooms, furniture and everything around it.
frames: The … is in front of / behind the …

truefalse.s: The lamp is next to the sofa.
The bed is in the kitchen.
The bath is in the bathroom.
The bike is in the garden.
The tree is in the garden.
There are two windows in the living room.
The clock is above the fire.
The fridge is in the bedroom.
The mirror is above the washbasin.
The kettle is on the worktop in the kitchen.
The coffee table is behind the sofa.
The ladder is leaning against the wall in the garage.
The suitcase is in the attic.
The wardrobe is next to the bed.
The cupboards are under the cooker.
The pillow is at the end of the bed, near the footboard.
The doormat is outside the front door.
A drainpipe carries rainwater down from the roof.
The skylight lets light into the attic.
The banister runs alongside the stairs.
The hedge is on the left of the house.
The lawnmower is kept in the kitchen.

A1: Which room is your favourite? Why?
What is in your bedroom? Use There is / There are.
Look at the kitchen in the picture. Write five sentences about it.
A2: Compare this house with your home. What is the same? What is different?
Imagine you live here. Describe your morning, room by room.
You want to sell this house. Write a short advert for it.
B1: Is it better to live in a house or a flat? Give your reasons.
Describe your dream home: the rooms, what is in them, and why.
Some things in this house need fixing (the gutter, the cobwebs…). Write a message to a builder.

rooms.ex: Leave your shoes in the hall, please.
rooms.def: The room just inside the front door. The stairs and the doors to other rooms start here.

rooms.ex: We watch films in the living room on Friday night.
rooms.def: The room where you sit, relax, talk and watch TV.

rooms.ex: Dad is making breakfast in the kitchen.
rooms.def: The room where you cook and keep food.

rooms.ex: The bathroom is at the end of the landing.
rooms.def: The space at the top of the stairs, with doors to the rooms upstairs.

rooms.ex: Someone's in the bathroom - wait a minute!
rooms.def: The room with a bath or shower, where you wash.

rooms.ex: My bedroom is small but it's got a big window.
Grandma's old photos are in a box in the attic.
rooms.def: The space under the roof, often used to keep old things.

rooms.ex: Put your bike in the garage when it rains.
rooms.def: A building or room where you keep a car or a bike.

rooms.ex: The children are playing in the garden.
rooms.def: The land next to a house, with grass, flowers or trees.

parts.ex: There's a cat on the roof!
parts.def: The top cover of a building.

parts.ex: Smoke is coming out of the chimney.
parts.def: A pipe on the roof that takes smoke from a fire up into the air.

parts.ex: The skylight lets sunlight into the attic.
parts.def: A window in a roof.

parts.ex: The gutter is full of leaves.
parts.def: An open pipe along the edge of a roof that collects rainwater.

parts.ex: Water was pouring out of the broken drainpipe.
parts.def: A pipe that carries rainwater from the roof down to the ground.

parts.ex: We waited in the porch until the rain stopped.
parts.def: A small roof or shelter over the front door.

parts.ex: The doorbell rang - it was the pizza!
parts.def: A button by the front door that rings when visitors press it.

parts.ex: The postman left the parcel on the doorstep.
parts.def: The step just outside the front door.

parts.ex: Our dog can jump over the fence.
parts.def: A wooden or metal wall around a garden.

parts.ex: Please close the gate behind you.
parts.def: A door in a fence or wall.

parts.ex: There's an old apple tree in our garden.
parts.def: A tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves.

parts.ex: She's planting flowers in front of the fence.
parts.def: The coloured part of a plant; plants grown for their colour.

parts.ex: Our neighbour cuts his hedge every Sunday.
parts.def: A line of bushes growing close together, like a green wall.

parts.ex: It's your turn to take the bin out.
parts.def: A big container for rubbish, kept outside.

parts.ex: Don't forget to lock the front door.
parts.def: The main door at the front of a house.

parts.ex: A letter fell through the letterbox.
parts.def: A narrow opening in a front door for letters.

parts.ex: Wipe your feet on the doormat!
parts.def: A small mat by the door for cleaning your shoes on.

parts.ex: She ran up the stairs to her room.
parts.def: Steps that go from one floor of a house to another.

parts.ex: Hold on to the banister - the stairs are steep.
parts.def: The rail at the side of the stairs that you hold on to.

parts.ex: The keys are on the floor.
parts.def: The flat surface you walk on inside a room.

parts.ex: There's a clock on the wall.
parts.def: One of the sides of a room or a building.

parts.ex: Can you open the window? It's hot.
parts.def: An opening in a wall with glass, to let in light.

parts.ex: Close the curtains - it's dark outside.
parts.def: Pieces of cloth that you pull across a window.

parts.ex: Turn on the lamp so you can read.
parts.def: A light that stands on the floor or on a table.

parts.ex: Grandpa is asleep on the sofa.
parts.def: A long soft seat for two or more people.

parts.ex: Put a cushion behind your back.
parts.def: A soft bag of cloth that makes a seat more comfortable.

parts.ex: Your magazine is on the coffee table.
parts.def: A low table in front of a sofa.

parts.ex: The cat sleeps on the rug by the fire.
parts.def: A small carpet that covers part of the floor.

parts.ex: Don't forget to water the plant.
parts.def: A living green thing that grows in soil, often in a pot.

parts.ex: We sat by the fireplace and drank hot chocolate.
parts.def: An open place in a wall where you can have a fire.

parts.ex: The clock on the mantelpiece is five minutes fast.
parts.def: A thing that shows the time.

parts.ex: The milk is in the fridge.
parts.def: A cold cupboard that keeps food fresh.

parts.ex: The glasses are in the cupboard above the kettle.
parts.def: A piece of furniture with doors and shelves, for plates, cups or food.

parts.ex: Be careful - the cooker is hot.
parts.def: A machine for cooking food, with an oven and rings on top.

parts.ex: Put the kettle on and let's have some tea.
parts.def: A pot with a spout and handle for boiling water.

parts.ex: There are dirty plates in the sink.
parts.def: A bowl in the kitchen with taps, where you wash dishes.

parts.ex: There's a picture of the sea on the landing.
parts.def: A painting, drawing or photo, often in a frame on the wall.

parts.ex: I have a quick shower every morning.
parts.def: A place where water comes down on you from above, to wash.

parts.ex: The baby is in the bath.
parts.def: A long container that you fill with water and sit in to wash.

parts.ex: He looked at himself in the mirror.
parts.def: Glass in which you can see yourself.

parts.ex: Wash your hands in the washbasin.
parts.def: A small bowl on the wall of a bathroom, with taps, for washing your hands and face.

parts.ex: Can I use your toilet, please?
parts.def: The seat with water in it that you use in the bathroom.

parts.ex: Here's a clean towel for you.
parts.def: A piece of soft cloth for drying yourself.

parts.ex: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
parts.def: A tall cupboard where you hang your clothes.

parts.ex: It's late - time for bed!
parts.def: A piece of furniture that you sleep on.

parts.ex: It's cold - I need a warmer duvet.
parts.def: A thick soft cover for a bed, filled with feathers.

parts.ex: She fell asleep as soon as her head touched the pillow.
parts.def: A soft thing to put your head on in bed.

parts.ex: My glasses are on the bedside table.
parts.def: A small table next to a bed.

parts.ex: The Christmas decorations are in those boxes.
parts.def: Containers, often made of cardboard, for keeping things in.

parts.ex: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
parts.def: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel.

parts.ex: The light bulb in the attic doesn't work.
parts.def: The glass part of a lamp that gives light.

parts.ex: The attic is full of dust and cobwebs.
parts.def: A net of thin threads made by a spider, often old and dusty.

parts.ex: I ride my bike to school.
parts.def: A bicycle: a machine with two wheels that you ride.

parts.ex: Dad climbed the ladder to clean the gutter.
parts.def: Two long pieces joined by steps, for climbing up.

parts.ex: The paint is on the top shelf.
parts.def: A flat board on a wall for putting things on.

parts.ex: The lawnmower is too loud on Sunday mornings.
parts.def: A machine for cutting grass.
